source.content: public class EventBusTailServiceState { public static Integer delivered = 0; }
trigger EventBusTailServiceTrigger on EventBus_Tail__e (after insert) { EventBusTailServiceState.delivered += Trigger.new.size(); }

@isTest private class EventBusTailServiceLocalEvidenceTest { @isTest static void clonePublishAndDeliver() { eventbus.TestBroker broker = Test.getEventBus(); eventbus.TestBroker brokerClone = (eventbus.TestBroker)broker.clone(); System.assert(broker !== brokerClone); eventbus.TestEventService service = new eventbus.TestEventService(); eventbus.TestEventService serviceClone = (eventbus.TestEventService)service.clone(); System.assert(service !== serviceClone); EventBusTailServiceState.delivered = 0; Test.startTest(); eventbus.TestEventService.publishEvent('EventBus_Tail__e', new Map<String,Object>{'Payload__c' => 'deliver'}); System.assertEquals(0, EventBusTailServiceState.delivered); broker.deliver(); System.assertEquals(1, EventBusTailServiceState.delivered); Test.stopTest(); } @isTest static void failQueuedEvent() { Test.startTest(); eventbus.TestEventService.publishEvent('EventBus_Tail__e', new Map<String,Object>{'Payload__c' => 'fail'}); Test.getEventBus().fail(); Test.stopTest(); } }
